noun_definition: Currency refers to the type of money, such as euro or rupee, that users can select when splitting a bill in the application, which is expected to yield consistent search results across different sections of the site.

ws default currency section refers to the area within a workspace settings where users can search for and select a default currency for transactions, specifically noted for its inconsistency in search results compared to other sections of the application.
Euro refers to a currency that users are attempting to search for in the default currency section of a workspace, but are encountering no results found.
Rupee refers to a currency that users are attempting to search for in the default currency section of a workspace within the application, but are encountering no results.
Results refers to the output displayed when searching for specific currencies, such as euro or rupee, in the default currency section of a workspace, which in this case shows "no results found."
